facts.program: Home Renovation Savings heat pump rules
facts.claim: Rented heat pumps qualify: $500/ton up to $2,000 (air source) or $3,000 (ground source) for any primary heat source. Pre-approval mandatory; participating contractor submits pre- and post-installation applications; cheque by mail within 60 days of post-install approval. Owner must apply; detached, semi, row, townhome or mobile home on permanent foundation; new builds (occupied 6 months or less) not eligible; Cornwall Electric customers not eligible unless heating with Enbridge gas. Gas-home ground source is $3,000.

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings windows and doors (assessment stream)
facts.claim: $100 per rough opening for each window, door, skylight or sliding door replaced with an ENERGY STAR certified model. Rebate is per rough opening, not per unit. A minimum of three window rough openings, or one door, skylight or sliding door rough opening, counts as one qualified measure; two windows alone earn nothing. Complete frame replacement only (glass, sash or door slab alone is not eligible). Professional installer; keep ENERGY STAR labels until the post-audit.
facts.eligibility: Owner of a single detached, semi-detached, row or townhome or mobile home on a permanent foundation, 6 months of occupancy, heated mainly by Enbridge gas, electricity, oil, propane or wood
facts.notes: Read the Nov 2025 eligibility PDF 2026-10-03. Triplexes, duplexes and stacked townhomes are not eligible; a house with a later-added secondary suite is.

facts.program: Home Renovation Savings assessment stream rules
facts.claim: Pre-audit before any work, at least two qualified measures, post-audit within 180 days of the pre-audit or by December 31, 2026, whichever is first, with post-audits scheduled in the tracking system by November 30, 2026. $600 audit rebate; $500 extra for three or more upgrades. Total cap $5,000 for Enbridge gas-heated homes and $10,000 for homes heated by electricity, oil, propane or wood. No double-dipping with earlier HER or HER+ rebates.
facts.eligibility: Registered energy advisor at an authorized service organization; Cornwall Electric customers excluded unless converting to or from Enbridge gas
facts.dates: Post-audit by Dec 31, 2026; scheduled by Nov 30, 2026
facts.notes: Whether the stream continues in 2027 is not stated in the Nov 2025 document. Re-check before quoting dates after 2026.
